answer: Hardware revenue dropped from 2,615,311.92 in Q2 2025 to 744,611.11 in Q3 2025. The main driver of this change was the number of orders, which was lower in Q3 at 238.0 compared to 699.0 in Q2, accounting for 85.76% of the change. Among other components, units sold was lower at 778.0 compared to 2,741.0 in Q2. Average order value was lower at 3,128.62 compared to 3,741.50 in Q2. Average unit price was about the same at 1,008.61 compared to 1,003.29 in Q2, and 1 minus average discount was also about the same at 0.95 compared to 0.95 in Q2, so they do not explain the difference. Revenue in earlier periods ranged from a low of 1,878,950.86 in Q3 2024 to a high of 2,615,311.92 in Q2 2025.
